82:t_002:3.en:
$$店長$$
「They're the space pilots you want to become...」

82:t_002:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Come on, small fry. This Earth doesn't belong to you.」

82:t_002:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「If you think you can throw your weight around here forever, you're dead wrong!」

82:t_003:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「All you've got is numbers...! You're a pain!」

82:t_004:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...It looks like you've gone and done it, Princess.」

82:t_004:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Picking a fight with $$サイデリアル$$... You're even more of a tomboy than usual, Princess.」

82:t_004:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It's fine. I don't like them, either.」

82:t_004:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'll help, Princess. Let's finish our mission and head back to $$メガネビュラ$$.」

82:t_005:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「With enemies this weak... Maybe you didn't need my help.」

82:t_005:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「By the way... Who's that girl?」

82:t_005:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're the waitress from that restaurant...」

82:t_005:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Thank you for saving me! $$ノノ$$ is so moved!」

82:t_005:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We help each other when we're in trouble.」

82:t_005:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! That's right! You're amazing, Big Sis~!」

82:t_005:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「If you're ever in trouble, $$ノノ$$ will gladly help you, too!」

82:t_005:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You're a space pilot, right, Big Sis?」

82:t_005:13.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...I thought you came from our world. Don't you recognize this uniform?」

82:t_005:14.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It's so cool! It's so adorable~!」

82:t_005:15.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We're $$フラタニティ$$'s $$宇宙怪獣$$ interception unit.」

82:t_005:17.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's great! I'm fired up! Seriously fired up!」

82:t_005:19.en:
$$ノノ$$
「So you're a righteous unit that fights $$宇宙怪獣$$, right?」

82:t_005:21.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You're heroes who protect everyone, right!?」

82:t_005:23.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ wants to be one, too. I want to become a space pilot like you and protect everyone, Big Sis!」

82:t_005:26.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ wants to become $$ノノリリ$$!!」

82:t_005:27.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Oh... $$ノノリリ$$ is someone who...!」

82:t_006:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$サイデリアル$$...! They've brought out manned machines!」

82:t_006:2.en:
$$サイデリアル兵$$
「We'll teach you Earthlings a lesson! We'll show you just how powerless you are!」

82:t_006:3.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Adults and $$サイデリアル$$ are the same... Neither wants to acknowledge our power.」

82:t_006:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Watch out, $$ニコラ$$! Here they come!」

82:t_008:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It looks like our real quarry has arrived.」

82:t_009:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$...! They were burrowing in the sand!」

82:t_009:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「There are more than I expected...! I never imagined so many had entered the atmosphere!」

82:t_009:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Wait, $$ニコラ$$...! Something else is coming!」

82:t_010:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「We spotted a battle and came to check it out, but...」

82:t_010:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「What the hell are those monsters...!?」

82:t_010:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Can you hear me, unit over there? Those are $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

82:t_010:4.en:
$n
「They seem different from the ones we've fought...」

82:t_010:5.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, cross-check the data.」

82:t_010:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「There is no matching species. The $$人類銀河同盟$$ has not encountered this type.」

82:t_010:7.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Amateurs should stay out of this. Leave it to us and fall back.」

82:t_010:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「What the hell! We were going to help you!」

82:t_010:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We're saying this for your own good. Please leave this to the $$トップレス$$.」

82:t_010:11.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You know about them, $$クルツ$$?」

82:t_010:13.en:
$$恵子$$
「H-He's definitely got the wrong idea...!」

82:t_010:14.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Sorry to disappoint you, $$クルツ$$, but they're like a special unit that doesn't belong to any organization.」

82:t_010:15.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「I've heard they act on their own judgment and fight something. Apparently, that something is these $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

82:t_010:17.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We can't ignore $$宇宙怪獣$$. We must repel them swiftly to keep the town from being damaged, too.」

82:t_010:18.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...I've warned you. If you still insist on interfering, I won't be responsible for what happens.」

82:t_010:19.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You should get out of here, too. You're in the way.」

82:t_010:21.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Hurry, unless you want to die.」

82:t_010:23.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$ヴァンセット$$ will support $$ディスヌフ$$.」

82:t_011:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Let's go, Princess. Let's show them our power... the power of the $$トップレス$$.」
